scope: Shared measured TPG 2x2 graph/bid priority and continuous Gaussian residual PPO with/without measured-risk KL. All four arms have identical continuous control permissions. Not original-author MAPPO reproduction or end-to-end independent planning.
low_control: Gaussian latent 3D action, delta=0.2/sqrt(3)*tanh(z), unit-ball command projection; forward nominal unavailable => exact shared conventional hold/retreat. Initial mean zero, std0.35; learned log_std clamped[-2.5,-0.7]. Actor uses own measured history, common current team packet and measured nominal candidate. No categorical default logit or greedy threshold.
anchor: For anchored variants only, low PPO adds 0.01*measured-risk-weight*KL(N(mu,sigma)||N(0,0.35)); same weight from age/ambiguity. Known regularization adaptation, unproven benefit. Unanchored controls retained because EXP0057 found categorical anchoring suppresses all deployed low interventions.
innovation_hypothesis: Smooth deterministic residual deployment makes small learned corrections operative; event graph and risk anchor contributions must be established separately by factorial controls. No claim that continuous PPO itself is novel.
shared_mechanics: Same measured inputs, rewards, fixed event triggers, default controller, nonpreemptive local reservations, physical limits and joint projection. All high policies learned; low losses masked when residual cannot affect control. Team reward and measured centralized critics remain common.
runtime: Same admitted clean CPython3.12/NumPy1.26.4/SciPy1.11.4/Torch2.3.0+cpu as EXP0057. Train and deploy all methods in this runtime. Any failed job blocks whole ranking; no retry or substitution.
selection: All 12 models trained from scratch for a fixed 16384-control pilot budget (196608 controls), no parent weights. Full 120-row matrix with N1 and strong classical controls. Final checkpoint only; 8 reused development layouts, no independent confirmation or convergence claim. No direct causal comparison to EXP0057's 32768 budget.
low_level_learning_evidence: Actual requested residual norm/nonzero counts, not conventional action-index counters. Greedy deployment uses Gaussian mean before fixed tanh transform; stochastic training actions scored in latent space.
claims: No hardware-calibrated magnetic separation, guaranteed safety, or established upper/lower algorithmic novelty. 2mm and residual command bounds unchanged simulation proxies.
